title: Quartic onsite obstruction to a positive-strip Weyl-Fourier carrier
question: Does the natural positive-strip L1 Weyl-Fourier analytic carrier remain invariant under the exact quartic onsite multiplication subflow of the Q3 model?

upstream_input.candidate: Weyl-Fourier analytic hierarchy with a positive exponential frequency moment and all-moment orbit-Frechet closure
upstream_input.scope: The exact test is on the one-component quartic onsite subflow, before kinetic and bond terms are added.

model.onsite_subflow: beta_t^V(W_a)=W_a exp(i t [V(q+a)-V(q)]/hbar) up to the declared sign convention

analytic_lemma.statement: If a coefficient density f has integral exp(rho|k|)|f(k)| dk finite for rho>0, its Fourier transform extends to a bounded holomorphic function on every narrower strip |Im z|<rho.
analytic_lemma.phase_growth: For kappa != 0, |exp(i P_(a,t)(x+i y))| grows like exp(3|kappa||y|x^2) on the side y*kappa<0, so the quartic phase is unbounded in every nonzero strip.
analytic_lemma.conclusion: The positive-strip L1 Weyl-Fourier representation cannot contain the quartic onsite image of any nonzero translation Weyl element at nonzero time.

scope.not_closed: This is a route-specific obstruction for a positive exponential Weyl-Fourier density/strip carrier. It does not rule out radius-free Frechet scales, Gevrey or subexponential weights, modular/state-weighted classes, direct D and delta-D convergence, or another Hamiltonian-derived common algebra.
